requirement: The account menu's AI accounts row shows the vendor marks and "Not connected" on the FIRST opening of the menu

oracle.ref: PR #1104 (fix); fix evidence: Measured on dev 09/10/2026 (tasks/evidence/account-menu/dev/hc-*.json): the first opening of the menu listed the AI accounts row as "AI accounts" alone; later openings showed the marks. The status read started only when the row mounted, i.e. when the menu opened.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. Starting the plugin (`apply`) asks GET /api/seat-plan/status once, before any menu opens. A row mounted before the answer shows "AI accounts" alone, then the marks and "Not connected" when the answer lands, without being mounted again. A row mounted after the answer shows the marks at once. Two copies of the client bundle on one page make one read and share one status: a Connect published by one shows on the row of the other.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
